or taking into the effect of biological interactions, such as competition, on the population dynamics.
Below two models are introduced which represent these two approaches when considering the way a
population changes over time.
I: discontinuous model of logistic growth:

Nt+1=Nt+rNt(1-K
Nt )

r: intrinsic per capita rate of population growth.

S : population size of sitters in generation t.
R : population size of rovers in generation t.
